Auto-plan completed with review: effort/risk below the full-decomposition threshold (pre-check verdict: skip — Small/Low at intake; re-estimated Small effort / Medium risk / 92% confidence after review).

Review summary:

1. **Requirements & AC alignment** — all 7 ACs trace to the intake brief. AC3 was rescoped as a *reuse* requirement against the existing `prefill_eta.py` calibration: `get_llama_local_status()` already emits `prefill_eta_seconds`/`queue_eta_seconds` (LP-0MVGDUV5E005UWBQ), so building a second estimator would duplicate it. AC5 (phase inference) and AC7 (staleness nulls) were promoted from risk notes to explicit ACs per producer answers.
2. **Completeness** — description, ACs, Implementation-context and Key Files sections present; `validate_key_files_format()` clean (6 paths, all with directory + extension); no children (leaf item); Appendix recorded.
3. **Sequencing & dependencies** — leaf item, no child ordering needed; test file named in Key Files so tests land with the change; separate measurement item LP-0MVGR2OXT0096OGK wired as dependent on this item.
4. **Scope sizing** — single end-to-end slice (handlers + observability reuse + calibration reuse + tests + docs); no horizontal phase split needed.
5. **Acceptance & testability** — each AC carries a concrete test (old-shaped-consumer contract, lease_state cases, capacity_hint decision table, phase cases, staleness nulls); AC6 verified via document existence.
6. **Polish & handoff** — decision table, phase-inference rule and reuse targets written so implementation needs no further design decisions.

AC coverage review: **proceed** — no uncovered ACs, no children created. Stage advanced to `plan_complete`. Effort/risk estimate recorded (17.4 h recommended, Medium risk, 92% confidence).
